question: As per the merger of public sector banks, effective from 1 April 2020, which of the following banks was merged with the Union Bank of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Corporation Bank.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India** announced through a circular that the** massive merger of 10 PSBs** will go into effect **on April 1, 2020**, the first day of the **next fiscal year.**
 
• Beginning on April 1, 2020, **all Andhra Bank and Corporation Bank branches **will function as **Union Bank of India branches.**
 
• **Customers** of Corporation Bank and Andhra Bank, as well as their **depositors,** will be regarded as **Union Bank of India clients. **
 
• Union Bank of India
 
 
• Founded: 11 November 191
